title: Craft Artists
description: Create or reproduce handmade objects for sale and exhibition using a variety of techniques, such as welding, weaving, pottery, and needlecraft.

tasks.text: Select materials for use based on strength, color, texture, balance, weight, size, malleability and other characteristics.
Create functional or decorative objects by hand, using a variety of methods and materials.
Develop concepts or creative ideas for craft objects.
Apply finishes to objects being crafted.
Cut, shape, fit, join, mold, or otherwise process materials, using hand tools, power tools, or machinery.
Set specifications for materials, dimensions, and finishes.
Advertise products and work, using media such as internet advertising and brochures.
Sketch or draw objects to be crafted.
Fabricate patterns or templates to guide craft production.
Create prototypes or models of objects to be crafted.
Develop product packaging, display, and pricing strategies.
Confer with customers to assess customer needs or obtain feedback.
Plan and attend craft shows to market products.
Develop designs using specialized computer software.
Research craft trends, venues, and customer buying patterns to inspire designs and marketing strategies.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.def: Understanding the implications of new information for both current and future problem-solving and decision-making.

skills.name: Persuasion
skills.def: Persuading others to change their minds or behavior.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Operations Analysis
skills.def: Analyzing needs and product requirements to create a design.

skills.name: Web page creation and editing software
skills.def: Software to develop or edit web sites or individual pages. Examples: Facebook.

skills.name: Computer aided design CAD software
skills.def: Software to design 2D or 3D objects. May include engineering or architectural features. Examples: DRAWSTITCH Artistic Sewing Suite, Electric Quilt Quilt Design Wizard, Embroidery design software, Floriani MDQ My Decorative Quilter.

skills.name: Electronic mail software
skills.def: Software to compose, send, or receive email. Examples: Email software.

skills.name: Analytical or scientific software
skills.def: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research. Examples: John Hesselberth and Ron Roy GlazeMaster.

skills.name: Point of sale POS software
skills.def: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports. Examples: Sales management software.

skills.name: Graphics or photo imaging software
skills.def: Software to draw or manipulate images. May adjust colors, add text, or apply special effects. Examples: SmugMug Flickr.
